name: Genius Loci
notes: CR 10. Guardian spirit of the sacred grove. Propitiation available.
gm_notes: Session 4 sacred grove. Only hostile if the grove itself is threatened (cutting trees, desecrating offerings, violent intrusion without ritual approach). Propitiation: DC 15 Religion check + genuine sacrifice (animal, weapon, or personal item of value) = it withdraws and allows passage. The ritual in Session 4 requires its permission. It has been here longer than Rome.
